description: Convert a document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, CSV, HTML, or image) to markdown. ASYNCHRONOUS: returns a job_id, NOT the markdown. Poll get_job_results (or get_conversion) until status=completed. There is no synchronous variant — extraction runs OCR and office conversion that can take minutes. Supply exactly one of media_id or content_base64.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes, for small files submitted inline. Capped at 10 MB decoded.

filename.description: Original filename. ADVISORY ONLY — the document type is detected from magic bytes, so a wrong or missing extension does not change how the file is parsed.

full_text.description: Default false. When false you get `preview` — the first 1500 characters. Set true for the complete `markdown` body. Leave it false if you only need to identify or classify the document; it is much cheaper to move.

media_id.description: SpiderMedia media_id of an already-uploaded document. Preferred for anything over a few MB.

mime_type.description: Declared MIME type. Advisory only, same as filename.

ocr.description: OCR policy for scans. auto (default) runs OCR only when there is no native text layer; never skips it entirely and is materially cheaper on a large scanned corpus — but returns an error for images, which have no text layer at all.

test.description: Route to the test queue instead of production workers.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: convert_document
